---
# Source: lapilli/templates/serviceaccount.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: ops-lapilli
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: lapilli
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: ops
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "dev"
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: Helm
    helm.sh/chart: lapilli-0.0.0
automountServiceAccountToken: false
---
# Source: lapilli/templates/cronjob.yaml
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata:
  name: ops-lapilli
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: lapilli
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: ops
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "dev"
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: Helm
    helm.sh/chart: lapilli-0.0.0
spec:
  schedule: "0 9 * * 1"
  timeZone: "Etc/UTC"
  concurrencyPolicy: Forbid
  successfulJobsHistoryLimit: 3
  failedJobsHistoryLimit: 3
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      backoffLimit: 0
      # --timeout, and ten minutes to report and send
      activeDeadlineSeconds: 3600
      template:
        metadata:
          labels:
            app.kubernetes.io/component: cronjob
            app.kubernetes.io/name: lapilli
            app.kubernetes.io/instance: ops
            app.kubernetes.io/version: "dev"
            app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: Helm
            helm.sh/chart: lapilli-0.0.0
        spec:
          restartPolicy: Never
          serviceAccountName: ops-lapilli
          # Mounted in lapilli's container, when a cloud's identity may need
          # it (lapilli.saToken).
          automountServiceAccountToken: false
          securityContext:
            runAsNonRoot: true
            runAsUser: 65532
            runAsGroup: 65532
            fsGroup: 65532
            seccompProfile:
              type: RuntimeDefault
          containers:
            - name: lapilli
              image: "ghcr.io/lapilli-project/lapilli:dev"
              imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
              args:
                - verdict
                - "--since=7d"
                - "--timeout=50m"
                - "--tz=Etc/UTC"
                - "--prometheus=http://prometheus:9090"
                - "--rules=/etc/lapilli/rules/0"
                - "--impact=up"
              env:
                # Keep the Go heap under the container's memory limit.
                - name: GOMEMLIMIT
                  valueFrom:
                    resourceFieldRef:
                      resource: limits.memory
                      # Said, not left to the API server's default ("0"): resourceFieldRef
                      # is atomic, so a GitOps diff of the applied fields sees the default
                      # as a change. "1" is the same value, in bytes.
                      divisor: "1"
              securityContext:
                allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
                readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
                capabilities:
                  drop: [ALL]
              resources:
                limits:
                  memory: 1Gi
                requests:
                  cpu: 100m
                  memory: 256Mi
              volumeMounts:
                - name: rules-0
                  mountPath: /etc/lapilli/rules/0
                  readOnly: true
          volumes:
            - name: rules-0
              configMap:
                name: rules
